title: Shindig — Partiful-style events and RSVPs
description: A React events app over resource-scoped membership: bootstrap-created events seat their host atomically, invites are displayable app data while the roster stays private, a first RSVP seats a guest through the declared self-insert transition, and the members-only event page / live guest list / wall are gated by the membership boundary rather than handler convention.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

react.toolchain: node>=24, cargo, bun install in surfaces/react, Chrome

contract.toolchain: node>=24, cargo build, bun install in surfaces/contract, Chrome

headless: createEvent bootstraps the event row and the host membership seat atomically
invites land as live feed rows while the roster stays private
an invited-but-unresponded guest receives the invariant role denial on the event page
a first RSVP seats a guest through the declared by:none self-insert transition and unlocks the gated queries
a changed RSVP takes the patch-only path and does not re-seat membership
membership-gated live queries deliver member fanout and never leak to non-members
react: the real create/invite/RSVP/wall flows work across three browser windows with live delivery
the locked event page renders the server denial honestly
non-member feeds observe none of the member activity
contract: the same flows work through the compiled .contract views over the multi-live surface
the membership-gated eventDetails subscription renders empty-rows as the locked page (no existence leak)
boot-bound live-query scoping: event selection is a navigation, one subscription per query name

capabilityGaps: no pending membership role: v1 setRole requires a memberId app handlers cannot discover (the roster is private), so the invited state lives in app data and the seat is created at first RSVP
notClaiming: sessions-mode auth (this demo runs the trusted-local dev mode with a persona switcher)
guest-list secrecy between members (every member sees every RSVP)
host transfer or uninvite flows (no remove/setRole transitions are declared)
